primary_task: Evaluate one incoming vulnerability report against the 7 brocards and produce the structured triage summary table with an overall ACCEPT, DISMISS or NEEDS-MORE-INFO verdict.

requirements.name: read
requirements.evidence: Check whether the vulnerable code path is reachable in practice. / For expanded explanations ... consult references/brocards-detail.md
requirements.basis: read: "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)"

notes: The triage is reasoning and writing done by the agent; no program, host or credential is required. Reading the codebase or the bundled reference file uses the read tool, which is available. The vulnbrocards.com link is attribution, not a required fetch. No unknown statuses; no alternative reading changes the verdict.
